queries.query: Our server test intermittently fails with EADDRINUSE only when CI runs several test processes in parallel.
A config test passes alone but changes after another test runs first because environment and fake-timer state leak.
The test server returns from teardown but a child process keeps running and mutates the next test.
In CI, every case rebuilds the same eight-second browser fixture, so the test lane is too slow; redesign the test layers without adding more timeout.
Optimize the production API so p95 latency drops from 300 ms to 150 ms.
Raise unit-test line coverage from 80% to 90% by adding assertions for untested branches.
Write a release test-plan document describing which product features should be checked manually.
Review the settings page screenshots for visual hierarchy and color consistency.
